settings.title: Everything Your School Needs, in One System

settings.html:
Attendance Management

Mark register in under 2 minutes per class. Real-time visibility for every teacher and the principal.

Student Profiles

Every learner's academic record, medical notes, parent contacts and fee status in one place.

Marks and Reports

Enter results once. Averages, rankings and report cards generate automatically.

Fee Tracking

See exactly who has paid, who owes and how much. Send payment reminders in one click.

Parent Communication

Notify parents about absences, results and school announcements directly from the system.

Principal Dashboard

Your whole school at a glance: attendance rates, fee collection and class performance updated live.

1

We Set It Up For You

We configure School Companion for your school: grades, subjects, staff accounts and fee structure. You provide the information, we do the technical work.

2

Your Staff Log In and Start

Teachers mark attendance and capture marks. Admin captures fees. The principal sees everything.

3

The System Does the Rest

Report cards generate automatically. Fee reminders go out automatically. You stay informed without chasing anyone.

settings.title: What School Companion Does Not Do (Yet)

settings.html:
• ✕
    SACE / GDE / DBE compliance reporting

    We are working on this and will add it in a future release.

  • ✕
    Integration with CEMIS (government schools system)

    School Companion is for independent and private schools, not government CEMIS users.

  • ✕
    Payroll processing

    Available as a paid add-on. Not included in the base subscription.

  • ✕
    Custom branded mobile app

    Not available at this stage. The system works on mobile browsers without an app.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Setting up our school management system takes just 5 working days for most schools. We handle the technical work: configuring your grades, subjects, staff accounts and fee structure. You simply provide the information.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Does it work during load shedding?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes. School Companion caches recent data so teachers can mark attendance offline. It syncs automatically when connectivity returns.
Parents receive automated notifications for absences, results and fee statements. A parent portal is available on the School and Campus tiers.
Your school's data is stored securely and is not shared with third parties. We use Google Firebase infrastructure with South African data residency.
Your data belongs to your school. On cancellation we export all records in standard formats and hand them over before your subscription ends.
Yes. Onboarding includes a live training session for your admin team and a short video library for teachers. Ongoing support is via email or WhatsApp.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Can we run it alongside our current system?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Yes, during transition. School Companion is designed to replace paper registers, Excel spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups over time. We help you migrate.
